name: Balimela–Munchangiputtu State Highway
significance: SH 47, Balimela–Munchangiputtu State Highway, crosses the border between Andhra Pradesh and Odisha. A state road that runs through more than one state has no single owner — AP R&B and Odisha Works Dept each maintain the stretch inside their own state, so which department to contact depends on where along the road you are.
